Tree House Vacation Rentals
Are you looking for a unique vacation experience surrounded by nature? If so, you should strongly consider renting a beautiful tree house!
Treehouse Paradise has had the good fortune of hosting guests from all over the world. We are located in Southern Oregon, about a 90-minute drive from Northern California. We have a wide range of tree house rentals available, including options for couples, groups, and families.
When you stay in one of our tree house rentals, you are really getting the best of both worlds: you’re enjoying an exciting adventure surrounded by nature, while still having modern amenities such as running water, flushing toilets, hot water showers, fridges, and more. Best of all, several of our tree houses are available to rent year-round, so you can enjoy the scenic beauty of each of the four seasons.
Things to Do Near Our Tree House Rentals
There are all sorts of fun activities to enjoy on and near our tree houses, including:
· Wine Tasting Sites
· Zip Lining
· Whitewater Rafting
· Gift Shops
· Fishing
· And More!
We are also near the Oregon Caves National Monument, Jet Boat Tours, Giant Redwood Forests, Great Cats Park, and the Burl Gallery. There are so many great experiences within driving distance while you stay in an amazing tree house!
Please note, you can make reservations online and can contact us with any questions.

Treehouse Paradise is renowned for its unique lodging in Southern Oregon. Our nature vacation rentals are ideal for individuals, groups, and families seeking a stay in nature in a tree house, with modern amenities that make it all the more comfortable.
Few things are better than spending time in a tree house as a kid, and it’s just as much fun when you’re an adult. Our tree house rentals feature something for all travelers.
Let’s take a look at your different options.
The Cottage Tree House
The beautiful Cottage Treehouse is available year-round! It has two full-sized beds, one in a loft, a fridge, hot water pot, hot water sink and flushing toilet. Shower at guest bath house. It’s a gorgeous option!
CLICK FOR COTTAGE
The Calypso Tree House
Available 12 months a year, the Calypso Treehouse is ideal for couples and features a queen bed, sink with hot water and flushing toilet, hot water pot and fridge. Shower at the guest bath house.
CLICK FOR CALYPSO
The Shiitake Tree House
The adventurous Shitake Treehouse, two full-sized beds in the loft. It also has hot water sink and flushing toilet. Plus, it has a fridge and kettle. Shower in the guest house.
CLICK FOR SHIITAKE
The Excalifir Tree House
Excalifir Treehouse is amazing. It’s two stories and features stained glass. It has two full beds, plus one fold-out queen. Microwave, fridge, hot water sink and 1/2 bath with shower.
To learn more about the tree houses we have for rent, contact us today.
CLICK FOR EXCALIFIR
